angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 63,099,990 km at 3591.90 pc = 0.23 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V916 Aql: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3591.9 +/- 204.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 3591.9 +/- 204.6 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2987 +/- 0.0173 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92), 17.3 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 90.7 +/- 4.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V916 Aql: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 90.7 +/- 4.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 63,099,990 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 250 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 308, Name='V916 Aql', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 250 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 308, Name='V916 Aql', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 250 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 0.52 from 2011AJ....141...53S; the 2 published values span log g 0.52 to 1.44, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.2% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011AJ....141...53S)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
